summary: The blueprint is broadly plausible for mouse E6.5-E8.5 gastrulation, but needs targeted refinement of trophoblast giant-cell coverage, endoderm trajectory specificity, blood-branch negatives, and a few marker modules.

issues.description: The trophoblast branch lacks a distinct trophoblast giant-cell state expected by E6.5-E8.5, and the ectoplacentalConeTrophoblast module mixes EPC/progenitor genes with differentiated TGC-like prolactin/cathepsin markers.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a trophoblast giant-cell module and gated child axis, preferably downstream of a refined EPC/progenitor parent. Move strongly differentiated TGC markers out of the EPC module and into the new child module.

issues.where: endoderm branch: posteriorVisceralGutEndoderm / gutTubeEndoderm / foregutEndoderm / hindgutEndoderm
issues.description: The blueprint recognizes visceral and definitive endoderm, but posteriorVisceralGutEndoderm conflates general visceral/yolk-sac endoderm, posterior/hindgut patterning, and definitive endoderm markers. This blurs the VE-derived and primitive-streak-derived gut trajectories that are important in this window.
issues.suggested_fix: Rework posteriorVisceralGutEndoderm in place into a cleaner posterior/extraembryonic visceral endoderm or VE-to-hindgut-transition module. Keep the definitive-endoderm-derived gutTubeEndoderm to foregut/hindgut path separate and use negatives only for true branch alternatives.

issues.description: These child axes are gated by bloodProgenitor but include endothelium as a negative. Endothelium is a sibling of bloodProgenitor one level up, not a sibling of erythroid, myeloid, and megakaryocyte fate under bloodProgenitor.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove endothelium from the negative_modules lists on the bloodProgenitor child axes. If needed, add a separate hemogenic-endothelium or EMP transition axis between hematoEndothelial and differentiated blood fates.

issues.description: The module includes plausible matrix/parietal endoderm markers but also broad mesenchymal or EMT genes such as Snai1, Vim, and shared Pdgfra, reducing specificity.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace the least specific EMT/mesenchymal genes with more canonical parietal endoderm-enriched markers supported in the atlas, such as Gata4, Sox7, Pth1r, Tinagl1, Srgn, or equivalent high-confidence genes.

issues.description: Amnion and yolk-sac/extraembryonic mesoderm are merged into one axis, which is somewhat coarse for the full E6.5-E8.5 landscape.
issues.suggested_fix: If the existing literature resources support it, split this into separate amnion and yolk-sac or extraembryonic mesoderm axes under nascentMesoderm, keeping allantois as a separate sibling.

out_of_scope: Resource DOI and impact-factor verification was not performed because citation checking is outside this discriminator pass.
